potential.name: Pedone et al. 2006 partial-charge rigid-ion (Coulomb + Morse + C/r^12)
potential.form: U(r) = qi qj e^2/(4 pi eps0 r) + D[(1 - exp(-a(r - r0)))^2 - 1] + C/r^12

notes: Table 2 column header for a_ij prints A^-2 in the extracted text; a appears inside exp(-a(r-r0)) so the unit is 1/A (standard reading).
Parameters were taken from a text extraction of the PDF; values were not cross-checked against a second source in this run.

Coulomb: damped shifted force (DSF, Fennell & Gezelter, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 234104 (2006)), alpha = 0.2 1/A, cutoff 10 A, instead of Ewald/PPPM, for speed (3.5x on this 2-core machine). Short-range cutoff 10 A (paper: 15 A; Morse terms are < 2e-5 eV at 10 A).
Implemented as one LAMMPS pair_style table (linear, 19201 points, 0.4-10 A) per pair containing DSF Coulomb + Morse + C/r^12.

protocol.engine: LAMMPS 22 Jul 2025 (PyPI wheel lammps 2025.7.22.4.0), 1 MPI rank per replica
stages: linear cool 3500 -> 300 K at 10 K/ps (320 ps)
300 K 50 ps (sites from last 20 ps, 10 frames every 2 ps)

dsf_vs_ewald_check.what: Replica rep3 final 300 K DSF structure: single-point comparison with PPPM/Ewald (1e-6), then 19 ps NVT 300 K re-equilibration with PPPM 1e-5 (10 frames over the last 9 ps) and the same site analysis
dsf_vs_ewald_check.conclusion: instantaneous DSF forces differ noticeably from Ewald, but the relaxed Er first shell is statistically unchanged
